description: 2EM Car Sharing is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Switzerland, country code CH. The MobilityData registry listed System ID zem_ch and GBFS versions 2.3 and 3.0, but its Baden-Württemberg endpoint returned HTTP 404 in the 7 October check. The current Swiss shared-mobility GBFS service lists system 2em_cars. Its system_information metadata identifies 2EM Car Sharing and links to https://www.2em.ch, matching this record. The 2.3 auto-discovery endpoint returned HTTP 200 on 8 October. Station and vehicle feeds were not read. The registry does not state feed-use charges; the licence field retains any provider declaration found in system-information metadata. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available. The related Mobility Database catalogue record documents the discovery source.
